name: @claude-flow/plugin-banking-demo
description: Hello-world banking-compliance plugin demonstrating the lub ruflo-compat path. Two illustrative tools that mirror the lub-ruflo-banking-pack design.
author: Rafael Martins Alves

tools.name: sr_11_7_check
tools.description: Take a model-risk claim and flag whether it cites a calibrated metric. Stand-in for the real sr_11_7_auditor agent in the future lub-ruflo-banking-pack.

claim.description: The text of the model-risk claim to check.

tools.name: regime_lookup
tools.description: Look up a regulatory regime by short name and return its canonical title plus the lub.reports enum key.
